input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: § 14.10 is one-directional: only Customer's assignment is restricted, while IBM is left free to assign the Agreement to anyone, including a competitor of ours, without notice or consent. That fails the fallback, which requires a mutual right to assign to successors and a mutual "consent not unreasonably withheld" standard for other assignments. The clause does contain an M&A successor carve-out for us and a reasonableness standard (so it is not walk-away), and there is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right anywhere in the document, but it lacks any affiliate carve-out for Customer and any restriction on IBM. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out and mirrors the consent restriction on IBM with a no-competitor limit, reaching the preferred position with the smallest change.

proposal.summary: Add affiliate carve-out for Customer assignment and make the assignment restriction mutual (IBM consent required, never to a Customer competitor).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an affiliate carve-out to our assignment right and made the restriction mutual, so IBM likewise needs our consent (not to be unreasonably withheld) and may not assign to a competitor of ours; as drafted only we were restricted. If helpful, we can instead agree a simple mutual right to assign to successors on written notice, with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.

ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition. Any attempted assignment in violation of the foregoing will be void. In any permitted assignment, Customer will remain liable for its obligations hereunder.
ops.newText: Customer may assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder, without the consent of IBM, to an entity controlling, controlled by or under common control with Customer or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets. Any other assignment by Customer requires the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. IBM will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of Customer, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Customer. Any attempted assignment in violation of the foregoing will be void. In any permitted assignment, the assigning party will remain liable for its obligations hereunder.
